title: Interactive 3D Card Flip
description: Build a card that flips to reveal a back side when hovered, using transitions, transforms, and 3D properties.
problemStatement:
Create a flip card component. On hover, the card rotates 180 degrees around the Y axis to show the back. **HTML structure:** ```html

Front

Hover me!

Back

Surprise!

``` **CSS requirements:** - `.flip-card` should have a fixed width (e.g., 300px) and height (200px), and `perspective: 1000px;` to enable 3D. - `.flip-card-inner` should have `transition: transform 0.6s;`, `transform-style: preserve-3d;`, and size to fill the parent. - On `.flip-card:hover .flip-card-inner`, apply `transform: rotateY(180deg);`. - Both `.flip-card-front` and `.flip-card-back` should: - `position: absolute;` fill the inner container. - `backface-visibility: hidden;`. - Styled with background colors, centered text, border-radius. - The back face must be pre‑rotated: `.flip-card-back { transform: rotateY(180deg); }`. Write full CSS (internal stylesheet) along with the HTML. Ensure it's a complete page with the viewport meta tag.
hints: Remember to set `width: 100%; height: 100%;` on the inner container so it matches the parent.
Use `display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;` on front/back for easy centering.
No JavaScript is needed; pure CSS hover.
expectedOutput: A card that flips smoothly on hover, with the back face correctly hidden until flipped.
